title: Croatian Stew with Peas and Kissed Vegetables
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew made with kissed tender vegetables and Croatian peas.

ingredients.name: Kissed tender vegetables (carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: Heat the stew in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the kissed tender vegetables and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the Croatian peas, vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
